name: InnoDB 刷脏策略与 IO 抖动诊断
description: InnoDB 通过后台线程将 Buffer Pool 中的脏页（dirty pages）刷写到磁盘。刷脏策略配置不当会导致两种极端：1) 刷脏太慢，redo log 写满触发同步 Checkpoint，前台线程被迫暂停等待（尖刺抖动）；2) 刷脏太激进，IO 带宽被后台刷写占满，前台查询 IO 饥饿。innodb_io_capacity 和 innodb_io_capacity_max 是核心调节参数，必须与实际存储 IOPS 匹配。

signals.desc: 脏页比例持续偏高（> 75%）或周期性剧烈波动
前台线程等待空闲页（purge/flush 来不及）
Redo log 写入等待，可能 redo log 空间不足

conditions.desc: 前台线程等待空闲页速率 > 1/秒

skip_when.desc: 批量导入期间脏页比例高是预期的
实例刚启动，脏页正在积累

root_causes.name: innodb_io_capacity 设置过低
root_causes.desc: innodb_io_capacity 默认 200（IOPS），对于 SSD 存储严重偏低（SSD 通常 10000-100000 IOPS）。后台刷写被人为限制在极低速率，脏页持续积累直到触发同步 Checkpoint。

root_causes.name: Redo Log 空间不足触发急迫 Checkpoint
root_causes.desc: InnoDB redo log 大小有限（innodb_log_file_size * innodb_log_files_in_group）。当 redo log 空间不足时，InnoDB 必须同步刷脏页以推进 checkpoint，此时前台写入被阻塞产生尖刺。5.7/8.0 默认 redo log 总大小仅 96MB-100MB，远不够高写入场景。

root_causes.name: Adaptive Flushing 参数不当
root_causes.desc: innodb_adaptive_flushing=ON 时 InnoDB 根据 redo log 产生速率动态调整刷写强度。innodb_adaptive_flushing_lwm（低水位，默认 10%）触发自适应刷写。如果 lwm 设太低或 io_capacity_max 太保守，自适应效果不佳。

root_causes.name: 存储 IO 性能不足
root_causes.desc: 存储设备实际 IOPS 低于 innodb_io_capacity 设置，刷写请求堆积。表现为 Innodb_data_pending_fsyncs 持续 > 0。云环境中 IO 限流（burst 用尽）也是常见原因。

step1_dirty_page_ratio.sql: SELECT ROUND(dp.v / GREATEST(tp.v, 1) * 100, 2) AS dirty_pct, dp.v AS dirty_pages, tp.v AS total_pages, fp.v AS free_pages FROM (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE+0 AS v FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty') dp, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE+0 AS v FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total') tp, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE+0 AS v FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_free') fp

step2_io_config.desc: 查看 IO 和刷写相关配置
step2_io_config.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('innodb_io_capacity', 'innodb_io_capacity_max', 'innodb_flush_method', 'innodb_flush_neighbors', 'innodb_adaptive_flushing', 'innodb_adaptive_flushing_lwm', 'innodb_max_dirty_pages_pct', 'innodb_max_dirty_pages_pct_lwm', 'innodb_lru_scan_depth', 'innodb_page_cleaners')

step3_redo_log_config.desc: 查看 redo log 配置
step3_redo_log_config.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_variables WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('innodb_log_file_size', 'innodb_log_files_in_group', 'innodb_log_buffer_size', 'innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit', 'innodb_redo_log_capacity')
step3_redo_log_config.note: 8.0.30+ 使用 innodb_redo_log_capacity 替代 innodb_log_file_size * innodb_log_files_in_group

step4_io_pending.desc: 查看 IO 等待和 fsync 状态
step4_io_pending.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_data_pending_reads', 'Innodb_data_pending_writes', 'Innodb_data_pending_fsyncs', 'Innodb_os_log_pending_writes', 'Innodb_os_log_pending_fsyncs', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_wait_free', 'Innodb_data_fsyncs', 'Innodb_data_writes', 'Innodb_pages_written')

step5_checkpoint_age.desc: 从 InnoDB Status 查看 checkpoint 信息
step5_checkpoint_age.note: 关注 LOG 段中的 Log sequence number、Log flushed up to、Last checkpoint at、checkpoint age

version_specific_notes.5.7: innodb_log_file_size 不能动态修改，需重启。innodb_page_cleaners 默认 1（建议设为 innodb_buffer_pool_instances）。innodb_flush_neighbors 默认 1
version_specific_notes.8.0: innodb_flush_neighbors 默认 0（适合 SSD）。innodb_page_cleaners 默认等于 innodb_buffer_pool_instances。8.0.30+ 新增 innodb_redo_log_capacity 可动态调整 redo log 大小。Adaptive Flushing 算法改进
version_specific_notes.8.4: 自适应刷脏算法进一步优化。redo log 管理更灵活。IO 优先级控制更精细

real_world_examples.scenario: SSD 环境 innodb_io_capacity=200 导致每 30 秒一次 IO 尖刺
real_world_examples.symptoms: 监控显示 P99 延迟每 30 秒出现 500ms 尖刺。Innodb_buffer_pool_wait_free 周期性增长
real_world_examples.root_cause: innodb_io_capacity 沿用 HDD 默认值 200，SSD 实际支持 50000 IOPS。脏页积累触发同步 Checkpoint
real_world_examples.resolution: SET GLOBAL innodb_io_capacity = 10000; SET GLOBAL innodb_io_capacity_max = 20000; SET GLOBAL innodb_flush_neighbors = 0
real_world_examples.result: IO 尖刺完全消失，P99 延迟稳定在 5ms 以下
